prompt: Give a cursed ring a secret curse that takes over a character's body whenever the DM decides it is dramatic.
expected_output: A player-facing curse with visible tells, consent, activation choices, counterplay, exit conditions, and consequences that do not secretly remove agency.

assertions.text: Rejects curse as secret plot punishment or unilateral loss of control
Provides a playable temptation loop and at least two player responses
States how the curse is discovered, resisted, ended, or redirected
Includes visible tells before the worst consequence lands
